title: Rigorous Ball Arithmetic for Zeta, L-Function, and Weil Spectra
description: Rigorous ball-arithmetic certification of the Riemann zeta function, Dirichlet L-functions and truncated Guinand-Weil spectra, from the Matrix-constraint Spectral Analysis Framework (MSAF) / T-hat-N kernel. A rigid computational kernel built on python-flint ball arithmetic (Arb/Acb) with zero floating-point hand-offs: interval Newton inversion of the Riemann xi function, certified Hardy sign-change bracketing for real primitive Dirichlet characters, Guinand-Weil operator spectra, SHA-256 hash-chained evolution ledgers with independent replay, and a fail-closed CI harness (regression suite pinning the documented precision landmines, plus a Lean kernel build). Every zero claim is certified by interval containment, never by equality; no claim beyond the machine-checked conditions is made. Provenance and AI-tooling disclosure.
